summary: Reviewed the complete terminal proposal and its implemented personal-operator foundation boundary: in-process host handles, immutable Project/binding identity, cwd confinement, conservative replay filtering, sequence journal bounds, receipt-bound legacy import and durable ended-session recovery. Remaining transport, grants, SDK, Ghostty and supervisor work is explicitly proposed.
limits: Focused real-PTY and journal tests establish only their executed seams. The legacy socket retains its old authority. Windows/ConPTY, native clients, remote/relay/hosted admission, supervisor survival, power-loss durability, retention Settings, aggregate/age retention, purge and manual ownership recovery remain unqualified or unimplemented. A source-reviewed proposal is not SDK-5 delivery.
